<div class="card-body">
'''E-web Blaster''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">E-web ブラスター</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の位置に配備する。1フォース余分に支払うことにより、2名の戦士で移動させることができる。同じ場所にいる自分の戦士が2フォース消費して起動できる。運命数を引く。目標がキャラクターかビークルなら、運命数＋1＞能力値／装甲値／回避値で命中する。目標が宇宙戦闘機なら運命数＞4で命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-E-web-Blaster-PSA-938999912.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">歩兵用兵器としては最大級のものであり、強力な光弾は宇宙戦闘機にすらダメージを与える。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' E-web Blaster.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy at any location. Two warriors may move it by paying 1 additional Force. One of your warriors at the same place may spend 2 Force to activate it. Draw destiny. A character or vehicle target is hit if destiny +1 exceeds ability, armor or maneuver. A starfighter target is hit if destiny exceeds 4.

'''Lore:'''
One of the largest infantry weapons. Its powerful light bolts can damage even starfighters.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The ordinary Japanese face has both the title and the printed fixed-weapon label.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[E-web Blaster]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
